description: Defines the crc_indication_builder class for constructing CRC indication messages, including methods to set basic parameters and add PDUs with various signal metrics.

classes.name: crc_indication_builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and populating CRC indication messages with parameters and PDUs.

methods.name: set_basic_parameters
methods.description: Sets the basic parameters of the CRC indication message, specifically the slot point.

methods.name: add_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PDU to the CRC indication message with various signal metrics and identifiers.
